tagline: DRAM, NAND and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI data centers, PCs, mobile and embedded.

fundamentals.asOf: Fiscal 2026 year ended Sep 3, 2026; prices as of Oct 7, 2026 close
notes: Q4 DRAM revenue $39.8B and NAND $14.1B; HBM revenue grew faster than total company revenue in Q4.
Management says the vast majority of calendar-2027 HBM bit supply is contracted at significantly higher prices YoY.
Guided ~$25B of capex for H1 FY27 (vs $27.4B for all of FY26).

calls.text: Consensus Strong Buy across 49 analysts; average target $1,560.57 (+57.8% vs the Oct 12 close)

catalysts.event: HBM bit supply mostly contracted at higher prices; NVHBM with NVIDIA in development

bull.text: FY26 revenue +256% with ~81% gross margin and $59B of free cash flow
Most of CY2027 HBM supply already contracted at higher prices
Forward P/E ~6× with Street targeting ~$1,555 (~43% upside)
Net cash ~$68B; board declared another $0.15 dividend

bear.text: Memory is cyclical: new supply can reverse pricing and margins quickly
Capex stepping up to ~$25B in H1 FY27 alone — cash conversion may compress
Customer and HBM concentration risk if AI buildout slows

news.title: Micron is down 30% from its high and back below $1 trillion
news.summary: MU's 5.63% drop to $878.84 left it worth $994.34B, nearly 30% below its $1,255 52-week high, after falls in six of seven sessions since Oct. 7 (−19.2%). The average analyst target of $1,560.57 implies about 77.6% upside; management says over 75% of 2027 output is already committed.

news.title: Micron drops 5.6% to $878.84 on CXMT competition fears and the AI selloff
news.summary: MU traded as low as $875 as worries grew that China's CXMT is advancing in DDR5, LPDDR5X and server memory; AMD fell 6%, Intel 5.8% and Broadcom 4.5% on the day (AP). Bernstein's Mark Newman said he sees value in memory stocks after the pullback.

news.title: Micron snaps a three-day slide, rising 1.9% to $931
news.summary: MU turned positive during the session after opening near $872, helped by ASML saying its capacity is booked through 2028; China's CXMT remains the main overhang after SK Hynix fell 11% and Samsung 10% in Seoul. MarketBeat's consensus is Moderate Buy with a $1,407.88 average target.

news.title: Micron drops another 4.1% to $914 on CXMT competition fears and hot CPI
news.summary: MU fell for a third straight day, closing at $914.13 (about 13% off last week's levels), as China's CXMT touted a denser 4F-square server DRAM design and inflation data hit chip stocks. Consensus remains Moderate Buy; Micron has signed 26 long-term customer agreements covering more than 75% of expected fiscal-2027 output.

news.title: Micron extends its slide as Netlist's ITC patent cases weigh on the memory trade
news.summary: Netlist is seeking U.S. import exclusion orders at the ITC over Micron's HBM3E/HBM4/HBM4E lines, and a separate ITC probe covers Micron DDR5 server modules (also naming Supermicro, HPE and Lenovo). Combined with CXMT's DRAM news, MU closed down 3.6% at $953.19, about 7% below Friday's close.

news.title: Micron falls ~4% as China's CXMT flags a denser server DRAM design
news.summary: CXMT said at a Shanghai industry event it has made major progress on a higher-density (4F²) DRAM cell and aims to launch a server memory product on it by year-end. Micron closed down 3.9% at $989.04 and SK Hynix fell about 4%; the next signal is whether CXMT's product ships and wins customer qualification.

news.title: Micron raises its buyback authorization to $35.16B from Dec 9
news.summary: Micron's FY2026 10-K (filed Oct 9) says the board raised its discretionary repurchase authorization to $35.16B effective Dec 9, 2026, subject to its CHIPS Act funding agreements; the program has no expiration and does not oblige any purchases. FY2026 revenue was $133.2B.

news.title: Deep in-the-money Micron puts suggest a synthetic short
news.summary: About $270M of Micron premium was tied to likely put buying, led by June 2028 puts at $2,250–$2,500 strikes; taken at face value a net ~$14.5M bearish spread with delta near −1. MU closed −0.66% at $1,029.

news.title: Micron and Nvidia bounce early after OpenAI's $70B revenue target
news.summary: OpenAI's projection of $70B+ annualized revenue by year-end eased AI-spending worries after Thursday's selloff; MU opened at $1,054 but faded to close lower.

news.title: Micron's Taoyuan union authorizes a strike over profit-sharing
news.summary: 1,994 of 2,012 voting members (88.3% of all eligible) backed strike action; no date is set and the union is weighing a short-notice "surprise strike." It wants 15% of operating profit shared with employees and rejected Micron's one-time NT$1.7M FY2026 package. The Taichung union's second mediation session is Oct 22; Micron says it will keep talking in good faith.

news.title: D.A. Davidson lifts Micron target to $3,000 from $2,100; MU closes +4.1% at $1,088
news.summary: D.A. Davidson keeps a Buy; consensus is Strong Buy from 49 analysts with an average target of ~$1,555.

news.title: Chip stocks slip premarket; Micron down ~2–3%
news.summary: Rising Treasury yields (10-year above 5.3%) and oil prices weighed on chips before the open; Citi has flagged mid-2027 as a possible memory-pricing peak as Samsung and SK Hynix add capacity.

listContext.method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP), rerun on the full US-listed market (StockAnalysis / S&P Global screener, Oct 16, 2026 close). A stock qualifies if it has: market cap of $10B or more and at least a year of trading history; TTM revenue growth of 15% or more that analysts expect to continue (consensus revenue growth of 8%+ next fiscal year and 8%+ a year over the next 3 years); a positive forward P/E of 35 or less and a PEG of 1.5 or less where available; a Buy or Strong Buy consensus from 5+ analysts with 15%+ upside to the average target; beta of 2.6 or less; share count up no
